title: Delete four dead domain-layer files in features/profiles/domain (pin_flow_machine.dart, profile_creation_use_case.dart, set_parent_pin_use_case.dart, verify_parent_pin_use_case.dart)
rule: AG-6 dead code / Fowler dead code

evidence.quote: /// The Riverpod adapter extends this with async fields (busy, lockedOut)

why: Repo-wide grep for the class names (PinFlowMachine, ProfileCreationUseCase, SetParentPinUseCase, VerifyParentPinUseCase) finds zero constructors/imports anywhere in lib/ outside each class's own file. ProfileCreationUseCase has a dedicated passing unit test (profile_creation_use_case_test.dart) that exercises code no production path ever runs; SetParentPinUseCase/VerifyParentPinUseCase have neither callers nor tests. pin_flow_machine.dart's own header claims PinFlowController 'wraps this machine' — false; PinFlowController reimplements the same state machine independently (see next finding). Combined this is 647 lines of orphaned domain logic (atomic profile+curriculum creation, PIN set/verify as sealed results) that misleads a reader into thinking PIN/profile-creation business rules live here, when the real logic is duplicated directly in the presentation layer.
recommendation: Delete all four files and their now-orphaned tests, or if the atomic profile+curriculum-seed behavior in ProfileCreationUseCase is actually wanted, wire it into a @riverpod provider and call it from showAddProfileDialog instead of ProfileRepositoryImpl.createProfile.
acceptance_criteria: grep for PinFlowMachine/ProfileCreationUseCase/SetParentPinUseCase/VerifyParentPinUseCase across lib/ returns zero hits outside deleted files (or, if kept, returns a real caller)
flutter analyze and dart run build_runner build stay clean after removal
orphaned test files for the deleted classes are removed in the same change
mergedFrom: Delete unreferenced pin_flow_machine.dart (340 lines) superseded by PinFlowController
